name: GutenQA
description: GutenQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate document segmentation methods for long-form narrative documents. It consists of 3000 'needle in a haystack' question-answer pairs derived from 100 public domain narrative books, measuring the ability to segment documents to improve retrieval performance.
reputation: A niche benchmark for document segmentation and retrieval on narrative books, with limited community adoption outside long-document processing research.
notes: Focuses on dynamic document segmentation to improve retrieval in narrative texts; benchmark derived from Project Gutenberg books.
